market_summary: US markets reopen Tue 1:30am AEDT after a weekend with little company news. Asia was mostly lower Monday: Kospi -2.8%, Nikkei -1.6%, Hang Seng +0.9%, ASX flat; Japan Q3 GDP shrank 0.1% annualised and China's October activity data disappointed. US futures dipped. The 10-year near 5.17% and a likely December hike remain the backdrop into Nvidia earnings Tue after US close (Wed morning AEDT), FOMC minutes Wed and the Anthropic IPO later in the week.
